findings: TOP BOTTLENECK: the slow tail's post-review interval. For the 5 slow PRs with full stage data, the median first-review-to-last-push interval was 67.0h. In this incident the evidence points primarily to queueing behind the coordinator, and the timestamps alone do not justify classifying that time as active rework.

ROOT CAUSE: Branch contamination + CI conflict coordination deadlock. Measured (not assumed): 8/11 PRs touching reconcile.mjs were contaminated (squash-merge relands under new SHAs). The group serialized 18 PRs for up to 64h while head-of-line PR #1976 carried 28/30 subject-matched duplicates and 45/48 patch-identical commits relative to main by git cherry. Emergency fix PR #2168 (coordination default-off) landed 2026-07-28 and drained the blockage.

SECONDARY ROOT CAUSE: Model-unavailability CI-recovery stalls. PR #2003 had a 70h gap where CI recovery was attempting to dispatch but the model was unavailable; the sweep retried on the same broken model instead of backing off. The new dispatch observability (PR #2129) will make future stalls diagnosable in seconds.

Guard friction is low and catch-correct. pr-preflight and pr-review-ledger each have 5 denies / 155 events (3.2%) — all verified as genuine policy violations, not mis-fires. authoring-main-sync: 2,757 allows / 0 denies — nominal.
Apple estimation is excellent: 89% exact, median |error| = 0.0 🍎 across 557 sessions. No systematic under-estimation.
PROPOSED SMALLEST FIX (see below): gate coordination on the effective current CI tree diff against main, while using patch-equivalence only as contamination diagnostics.

proposedFix.title: Effective CI tree-diff admission gate in CI conflict coordinator
proposedFix.currentBehavior: isCiCoordinationPath() flags a PR as touching CI files if ANY diff file matches the path pattern. Branch contamination (squash-merge carries prior-session commits under new SHAs) causes innocent art/docs PRs to match, creating false-positive coordination groups.
proposedFix.proposedChange: Use patch-equivalence (`git cherry`) only to report suspected relocated history. Decide coordination from the path-limited tree diff instead: if `git diff --quiet origin/main...<head> -- .github/workflows .github/scripts/ci-*` is empty, keep the PR out of CI coordination as a CI no-op. If the diff is non-empty—or cannot be evaluated—keep the PR coordinated (or require a rebase/escalation) so #2137-style real CI reverts do not bypass the fence.
proposedFix.measurability: Primary metric: coordinated PRs whose effective CI diff against main is empty. Before fix: observed false positives in the 2026-07-28 deadlock. After fix: target 0. Secondary monitoring metric: contaminated PRs among PRs touching reconcile.mjs (8/11 measured on 2026-07-28) should trend toward 0 after branch hygiene improves. Would allow CI_CONFLICT_COORDINATION_ENFORCE to be re-enabled safely.
proposedFix.scope: Tooling-only — no gameplay or runtime change. Cap: 3🍎 per tooling-only ceiling.
proposedFix.effort: 2–3🍎 estimated. Requires: (1) a path-limited effective-diff helper, (2) coordinator integration, (3) unit tests with real-git fixtures, (4) a false-positive metric reported in the CI-health canvas.
alternativesConsidered: Keep coordination default-off permanently — accepted risk: when re-enabled for any reason, the false-positive problem recurs silently.
Rebase all agent branches before grouping — heavier (requires write access per PR), still doesn't prevent new contamination on long-lived PRs.
Filter by commit count (skip PRs with >50% patch-identical commits) — useful contamination evidence, but not authoritative for whether the resulting CI tree still changes main.
